name: Tom Volz Repeat Purchase Reminders for WooCommerce
author: Tom Volz

sections.description:
Bring existing WooCommerce customers back when it is time to buy again.

Tom Volz Repeat Purchase Reminders for WooCommerce automatically schedules reminder emails after completed orders. Instead of relying on a single fixed reminder, you can create and manage multiple customer reminder campaigns with your own timing, subjects and email content.

The free version already includes the core reminder workflow:

  • Unlimited customer reminder campaigns
  • Custom delay in days or months
  • Custom email subject and content
  • Automatic follow-up scheduling after completed orders
  • Scheduled, sent and failed email overview
  • Test email function
  • Synchronize existing completed orders
  • Customer unsubscribe link

More than a basic reorder reminder

The plugin is designed around campaigns, not just one-off reminder rules.

You can create unlimited reminder campaigns, choose when each campaign should run, customize the message and review the resulting delivery activity.

Pro adds the next level of retention automation:

  • Product targeting
  • Recurring reminders
  • Customer segmentation
  • Smart timing
  • Cross-selling
  • Automatic coupons and offers
  • Click and conversion tracking
  • Revenue attribution
  • A/B testing
  • Multi-step campaigns

This lets you move from a simple “remind the customer later” workflow to targeted, repeatable and measurable follow-up campaigns.

Features

  • Unlimited customer reminder campaigns
  • Custom delay in days or months
  • Custom subject and email text
  • Automatic follow-up scheduling after completed orders
  • Scheduled, sent and failed email overview
  • Test email function
  • Synchronize existing completed orders
  • Customer unsubscribe link
  • WordPress Cron and wp_mail()
  • Customizable email placeholders

How it works

  1. Create a reminder campaign.
  2. Choose the delay after the completed order.
  3. Write your subject and email content.
  4. Save the campaign.
  5. The reminder is scheduled automatically.
  6. Review scheduled, sent and failed reminder emails in the delivery overview.

Pro

Pro adds advanced retention automation for stores that need more than basic follow-ups.

Product targeting, recurring reminders, customer segments, smart timing, cross-selling, offers, click/conversion tracking, revenue attribution, A/B testing and multi-step campaigns are available in Pro.

Privacy

The plugin stores order ID, customer ID, email address, scheduled time and delivery status in the WordPress database for reminder management.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Tom Volz Repeat Purchase Reminders for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Repeat Purchase Reminders in the WordPress admin.
  5. Create a reminder campaign and customize the email content.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

When are reminders scheduled?

Reminders are scheduled automatically when an order reaches the completed status. Existing completed orders can be synchronized manually.

Can I create multiple reminder campaigns?

Yes. The free version supports unlimited customer reminder campaigns.

Can I create recurring reminders?

Recurring reminders are available in Pro.

How are emails sent?

Emails are sent through WordPress wp_mail(). Reliable delivery depends on your site’s mail configuration.
